sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Rotocasting Injection and Airbrush Finishing of Vinyl Art Collectibles

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English Common Law foundation (companies and commercial law), with residual French Civil Law influence and customary law (Constitution of Vanuatu 1980)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus), ratified party
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement in Goods
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with Australia (2010)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with New Zealand (2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Act [Cap 283] (Act No. 29 of 2006), as amended through the 2017 and 2022 amendment waves, establishing the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organised Crime Act (2005); International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Act No. 24 of 1992), ss. 12, 24-27, 33-38 (name, registered office, registered agent, registers of members and directors); beneficial ownership recording and disclosure regime introduced by Companies (Amendment) Acts 2020-2022 and administered under VFIU/VFSC directives implementing FATF Recommendations 24 and 25.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or notary public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if country of origin is a Convention party) else Vanuatu Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original police clearance certificate / criminal record certificate of each individual UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal records authority in country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney appointing the Vanuatu licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter covering each UBO and the intended corporate relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated financial institution of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct from bank to licensed agent; consular legalization not ordinarily required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth/funds declaration with six months bank statements of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature; apostille or consular legalization required for foreign notarial acts

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate UBO certificate and certificate of good standing where any shareholder is a legal entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent registrar of the foreign jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, signatories and their immediate associates against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, Interpol Red Notices, and the Vanuatu FIU national designated persons list; mandatory PEP flagging with enhanced due diligence for foreign and domestic PEPs sourced from World Bank and anti-corruption authority databases; fuzzy-match alert threshold at 55% similarity; re-screening every 180 days and upon any triggering event; suspicious transaction reporting to VFIU where any indicator is substantiated.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Register (name clearance submitted by a licensed registered agent through the VFSC authorized-agent portal; preliminary availability may be checked via the VFSC online public search at vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered names must be in English or French using the Latin alphabet; Bislama terms are permissible in trading names but not as a doctrinal substitute; where a brand name is non-Latin (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Korean), a certified romanized transliteration must be registered as the official name and a cross-reference to the proprietary trademark may be lodged in the company file.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed agent may resubmit an amended name within 5 business days; if the same objection persists, a written appeal for administrative reconsideration must be filed with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, attaching legal memoranda and any prior consenting approval from the relevant national regulator (e.g., Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for banking tokens); a still-adverse determination may be challenged by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu, with a further 30-day expedited re-application window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted: the IC must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the address of its licensed registered agent; no physical staff or premises in Vanuatu are required, and the entire trading, merchandising and manufacturing operations (rotocasting, injection moulding, airbrush finishing) may be conducted outside Vanuatu. A virtual-office arrangement with the licensed agent is standard and compliant. Caution: payment rails (Shopify Payments, Stripe) will conduct independent UBO and address KYC; a genuine operational HQ abroad and separate local trade registration may be required for acquiring-bank underwriting.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated 1-2% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the IC itself, as non-resident exempt companies conduct no Vanuatu activities; VFSC and VFIU conduct scheduled and risk-triggered supervision of licensed agent premises rather than the IC's foreign facilities (estimated 5-8% annual probability of an agent-office examination).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Republic of Vanuatu; ss. 4–7 (incorporation and registered office), ss. 9–10 (directors and secretary), s. 12 (shares) and s. 21 (seal)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company (Form IC-1 Application for Registration)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; nominal subscribed share capital is permissible, shares need not be fully paid at incorporation, and no escrow or capital deposit account is required for an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscription of one (1) ordinary share at par by the sole Subscriber be and is hereby approved, and the Subscriber is entered in the Register of Members. (2) That the registered office situated at the office of the Registered Agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu, be and is hereby adopted as the Company's statutory registered office. (3) That the first Directors be and are hereby appointed, and the Corporate Secretary is appointed. (4) That the Directors be and are hereby authorized to open bank accounts, negotiate contracts with payment processors, and execute ancillary documents. (5) That the Common Seal be and is hereby adopted, and these minutes are effective as of the date of adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry – Online Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed Registered Agent submits the proposed company name to VFSC for pre-clearance through the online portal. VFSC verifies the name against the International Companies Register, local Companies Register, and protected-name list. The reservation is valid for 90 days and is required to be quoted in the subsequent application for registration.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (with up to three alternatives)
Registered Agent cover letter requesting name reservation
Certified passport copies of the proposed subscriber and directors
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank reference) for each appointee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or objectionability, the Registered Agent submits the next alternative name and re-applies without penalty. Where the applicant contests the decision, a written request for reconsideration may be filed with VFSC within 14 days, and the final determination is given within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Port Vila with Notarization before a Vanuatu Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The sole subscriber executes the instrument before the Registered Agent; the signature is notarized and the Registered Agent annexes its consent to act as Registered Agent together with its own license certificate and registered office confirmation.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as Director (and Secretary) from each appointee
Subscriber due diligence file: certified passport, one professional reference, and proof of source of funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical or notarial defects are cured by re-executing only the defective pages and re-notarizing within 2 business days. If the Registered Agent declines to continue, a substitute licensed agent is appointed by a written substitution deed and the consent form is re-executed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment with VFSC and Payment of Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registry Counter or Authorized E-Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent lodges the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, Form IC-1, schedules of directors and shareholders, registered office declaration, and the USD 300 government fee. Payment is made via bank transfer to the VFSC designated account or card through the e-portal. VFSC issues an acknowledgment receipt bearing the registry file number.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered Office Consent and Registered Agent Consent
Name reservation confirmation and statutory fee receipt
Schedules of directors, secretary, and issued share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query, the Registered Agent answers in writing within 7 calendar days. Deficient schedules are resubmitted electronically once corrected. Documents found not in registrable form are recast and re-filed within 5 business days, and any additional fee charged by VFSC is settled before final acceptance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry / Registered Agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The Registered Agent collects the certificate and assembles the corporate kit comprising the share certificate, common seal, statutory registers, and certified copies of the constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgment of registration issued by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical or spelling errors, a replacement certificate is requested via a Rectification Application, which VFSC processes within 3 business days. In the event of an electronic registry delay, the VFSC register entry is controlling and the certificate is re-issued upon verification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Bank Account Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / Registered Agent / Licensed Vanuatu or Correspondent Bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass a written resolution adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution. Appoint the officers, adopt the seal, and approve the opening of the corporate bank account and payment-rail agreements (Shopify Payments, Stripe, and local POS). Execute bank mandates and provide certified corporate documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association
Minutes of the First Board Meeting or written resolution
Certified passport copies and proof of address for signatories
Bank account opening forms, corporate good-standing references, and payment processor agreements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the onboarding bank requires enhanced due diligence, the Registered Agent supplements the file with certified statutory registers and director biographical information. If a director is not accepted by the bank, a substitute director is appointed by board resolution, a Form IC-10 notice is filed with VFSC, and the bank mandate is updated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Customs and Inland Revenue – Business Licence Division, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Investment
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trade Business Licence issued under the Business Licence Act, together with a Foreign Investment Certificate (where non-resident ownership exceeds the prescribed threshold) for the manufacturing and wholesale export of designer vinyl toys

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) – Vanuatu, under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act 2003
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C – Low Risk Small-Scale Light Manufacturing: environmental registration with a simple Environmental Management Plan; a full EIA Report is not triggered where VOC solvent usage is below 100 kg per year and no discharge enters a protected water body
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must meet the Vanuatu National Effluent Standards: pH 6.5–8.5, BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, and oil/grease ≤ 10 mg/L. Airbrush finishing emissions shall not exceed the 100 ppm occupational exposure threshold for VOCs, and waste handling must follow DEPC-approved segregation protocols with licensed removal of vinyl scrap and paint sludge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Compliance Certificate from the Vanuatu National Fire Service, duly approved exit routes and extinguisher placement; structural load inspection of the production floor by the Public Works Department; electrical installation certificate from a licensed electrician registered with UNELCO; and occupational workplace clearance under the Health and Safety at Work Act including ventilation, protective equipment, and first-aid requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), the unified tax and customs administration of Vanuatu; official digital portal administered at www.vrca.gov.vu, complemented by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Company incorporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] via a VFSC-registered agent; obtain Certificate of Incorporation and IC registration number. 2) Apply to VRCA for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using Form TIN-01, supported by certified incorporation documents, registered office address, and director/officer particulars; issuance occurs within 3-5 business days and is mandatory even for tax-exempt entities. 3) Because the IC is prohibited from conducting domestic business with Vanuatu residents, it remains outside the VAT net; a separate VAT registration is only triggered if the IC pivots to permitted domestic taxable supplies. 4) Obtain the IC Tax Exemption Certificate from VFSC evidencing exemption under s.122 of the IC Act. No minimum capital, local shareholding, or physical office is required for IC status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — International Companies are statutorily exempt from Vanuatu corporate income tax (Vanuatu currently imposes no income tax regime), capital gains tax, withholding tax, dividend tax, and exchange control; VAT applies only upon domestic taxable supplies, which an IC may not ordinarily undertake.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or transparent-entity election exists in Vanuatu. Available statutory elections are limited to: (a) voluntary VAT registration for suppliers below the VUV 5,000,000 threshold (s.6 VAT Act [Cap 248]); (b) irrevocable election to be governed as an International Company under the IC Act, securing the statutory tax exemption; and (c) optional issuance of a VFSC Tax Exemption Certificate to facilitate counterparty due diligence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover (approximately USD 42,000), mandatory registration threshold; voluntary registration permitted below the threshold but imposes full VAT compliance obligations for a minimum of 24 months.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government API stamping, or mandatory e-invoicing network has been implemented in Vanuatu; taxpayers must issue paper or digital VAT invoices containing prescribed particulars under s.21 of the VAT Act and retain fiscal records for 7 years; no digital fiscalisation or invoice clearance certification is currently required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to goods (including designer blind box toys) physically exported from Vanuatu by the supplier, provided the goods are removed within the statutory export period and the supplier holds prescribed documentary proof of export (s.8 VAT Act); services supplied to non-residents are zero-rated where the benefit is wholly received outside Vanuatu; zero-rated refund claims are processed via periodic VAT return, not separate refund filing.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (VRCA Export Entry / EDIFACT electronic export lodgement)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from a Vanuatu port
Commercial Invoice and export sales contract
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank settlement confirmation evidencing foreign currency payment
VAT invoice marked 'Zero-Rated Export' bearing supplier TIN
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA audit applies longitudinal scrutiny of export documentation-to-remittance matching; fraudulent zero-rating or refund misstatement triggers a monthly default penalty of 10% of unpaid tax (s.35 VAT Act), criminal liability with fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 10 years (s.38 VAT Act), retrospective reassessment within 5 years and unlimited limitation in fraud cases; clawback of refunded VAT plus interest applies, and destruction of export records within the mandatory 7-year retention period is independently sanctionable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — sole monetary authority, prudential banking regulator and foreign-exchange administrator; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — regulator and corporate registry for Vanuatu International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu abolished exchange controls in 1988. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are legally unrestricted, and no exchange-control approval is required for inbound equity, outbound trade settlements, dividends or cross-border loan servicing. The vatu (VUV) operates under an RBV-managed float referenced to a USD/AUD basket; VUV is effectively non-deliverable offshore, but on-island conversion between VUV, USD, AUD, NZD and EUR is freely available at commercial bank rates. The Vanuatu International Company (IC) pays zero corporate income tax and zero withholding tax on distributions, so profit repatriation is tax-free. The practical residual hurdle is counterparty de-risking by foreign correspondent banks, not local statute.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None imposed. There is no statutory timeline for repatriation of export proceeds and no mandatory conversion ratio into vatu; designers and manufacturers may retain USD/AUD export earnings in foreign-currency accounts. Banks nonetheless file international funds transfer reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) for wire transfers above the prescribed threshold (currently approximately VUV 1,000,000) and will require underlying documentation — pro-forma invoice, commercial invoice, bill of lading and customs declaration (HS code 9503.00) — to evidence genuine designer-blind-box trade flows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Operational & Settlement Account (VUV/AUD/USD/NZD) plus segregated USD Capital Escrow and FX Forward Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Trade Settlement Account and segregated USD Collections Account for Shopify/Stripe payouts
VUV/USD Treasury and Cross-border Escrow Account
VUV Domestic Disbursement and Payroll Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility rating. Vanuatu has no dedicated domestic EMI licensing regime, so a VU International Company cannot obtain a full-service local electronic-money licence. Offshore EU/FCA-ADGM or Australian-regulated EMIs (including global FX wallet and mass-payout platforms) can be engaged for USD/AUD/HKD collections and Shopify settlement, but they routinely apply heightened due diligence to zero-tax Vanuatu ICs, require proof of substance, and face unstable correspondent access under global Pacific de-risking. The nominated Vanuatu commercial bank should therefore remain the primary liquidity spine, with EMIs used only as secondary collection rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hybrid-mandatory policy. A licensed Vanuatu registered agent must co-apply for account opening. At least one director or the attorney-in-fact under a notarised power of attorney must physically attend the initial interview and signatory verification at the Port Vila branch. Remote account opening is permitted only where the introducing registered agent maintains a long-standing KYC relationship with the bank; even then, apostilled passports, notarised corporate resolutions, banker's references and complete UBO declarations are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero-tax Vanuatu International Company with an opaque offshore shareholding chain - flagged as jurisdiction-de-risking or shell-company risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; certified extract from the International Companies Register confirming non-bearer share structure; registered agent compliance certificate; UBO declaration with identity, address, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence for all natural persons; board resolution authorising the account; 3-year business plan for designer blind-box licensing, design and merchandising; bank reference letter from a prior institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value global card settlements from Shopify/Stripe with elevated chargeback ratios and IP-royalty payments to Hong Kong or China-based design studios.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant settlement statements and payout logs; USPTO/CNIPA/HK trademark registration certificates; IP licence agreements with royalty schedules; manufacturing and labour-hour contracts; supplier purchase orders, commercial invoices, packing lists and bills of lading; customs declarations (HS 9503.00); chargeback/refund policy and customer-service KPIs; periodic physical inventory ledger and 3PL warehouse reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wire activity to or from jurisdictions under FATF/EU enhanced monitoring (e.g., certain Asian and UAE corridors) inconsistent with the declared trade pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed distribution, licensing and manufacturing contracts; beneficial-ownership confirmation for each counterparty; distribution territory exclusivity terms; customs entry data; transaction-by-transaction dossiers matching invoice value, payment value and delivery evidence; director attestation of continued trade purpose; express consent to ongoing sanctions and adverse-media screening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived absence of economic substance in Vanuatu despite significant global brand sales volumes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office lease and licensed fiduciary/trustee arrangement in Port Vila; contracted corporate secretary; treasury administration genuinely executed from Vanuatu (island-based account signatories); website, domain, e-commerce and trademark portfolio evidence; annual IC return and registry fee receipts; economic-substance declaration (if triggered) confirming non-resident ownership with genuinely offshore commercial activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires a single SWIFT MT103 from the parent/shareholder to the IC's USD or VUV settlement account at ANZ/BSP Vanuatu, with payment narrative: 'Shareholder capital contribution - [VU_IC legal name] - VFSC registry no. [number] - board resolution dated [date]'. A pre-advice copy of the signed board resolution, source-of-funds pack and corporate KYC file must be delivered to the receiving bank. No exchange-control permit or RBV approval is required; the bank will report the inbound credit to the VFIU if above the wire-reporting threshold and the remitter's name must match the KYC record. Structuring the injection into sub-threshold tranches to avoid reporting is prohibited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 from ANZ/BSP Vanuatu to the factory or design studio in Asia (typically Hong Kong or mainland China), referencing the PO and invoice number in field 70. For larger purchase orders, USD-denominated sight letters of credit may be advised through ANZ's Melbourne trade desk or BSP's Port Moresby trade desk under ICC UCP 600, with 60-day usance only after credit facility approval. Sub-USD 10,000 supplier payments can be executed via approved overseas EMI mass-payout platforms (AUD/HKD rails), but remain subject to enhanced corridor review. Every disbursement must be supported by PO, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading and customs declaration attached to the trade file, and beneficiary-name screening must clear prior to release.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV FX forward with tenors up to 12 months contracted through ANZ Vanuatu or BSP Vanuatu treasury desks - no exchange-control authorisation required.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/VUV with an FCA- or Australian-regulated offshore bank, USD cash-settled outside Vanuatu - permissible because exchange controls were abolished and derivative gains are tax-exempt for the IC.
Cross-currency swap (USD principal versus VUV floating) under an English-law ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a licensed Australian/NZ/UK counterparty, cash-collateralised in the Vanuatu USD account.
Zero-cost FX collar options (USD call/VUV put and VUV call/USD put) purchased from a licensed non-resident dealer - no premium withholding or local regulatory approval applies.
FX spot and value-today FX swaps executed on-island in the VUV/USD interbank market for day-to-day working capital and supplier settlement timing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Vanuatu International Company Government Fee (annual license fee due to VFSC, submitted by licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of the date of registration; registered agent issues the renewal invoice approximately 30 days before the anniversary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-payment penalty of 5% per month (or part month) accrues after the anniversary. If payment remains outstanding for 90 days, VFSC may strike the International Company off the International Register and dissolve it, extinguishing limited liability and vesting the company's assets in the government.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of registered office, registered agent, directors, members, and beneficial ownership schedule (AML/CTF compliance questionnaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent acting for VFSC AML/CTF supervision; not a public filing with VFSC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the registered agent's annual renewal request, or on the anniversary date if the engagement letter specifies that date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide the annual confirmation within the agreed window constitutes a breach of the registered agent agreement and may lead to the agent's resignation. If the company fails to appoint a replacement registered agent within 21 days, VFSC may strike the company off the register.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Vanuatu International Company is never subject to a mandatory independent audit under the International Companies Act [CAP 222], irrespective of turnover, assets, shareholding or public-interest status. The VFSC may only require an audit by specific order in exceptional AML/CTF or investigation cases; audited financial statements are not required to be filed with the VFSC.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework applies. If financial statements are voluntarily prepared, they are typically prepared under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or another standard acceptable to users, faithfully presenting the company's financial position. The statutory requirement is limited to maintaining adequate accounting records reflecting transactions, assets and liabilities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Vanuatu registered agent is required by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) legislative framework to hold current beneficial ownership information. Annually, the company must confirm the accuracy of its UBO schedule and register updates; any share transfer or beneficial ownership change must be recorded in the member register and notified to the registered agent within 14 days. No public UBO register filing is required in Vanuatu.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – USD 700 per annum inclusive of registered agent fee and registered office fee
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable – no statutory audit. If a voluntary independent review or compilation is requested by board or finance providers: USD 1,500 – USD 4,000 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company status confers a permanent statutory exemption from corporate income tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, and all withholding taxes. No tax holiday application is required. Profits derived from overseas e-commerce sales of designer blind box toys are wholly outside the Vanuatu tax net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax return. The sole statutory annual compliance filing for an International Company is the Form 9 Annual Return submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due no later than six months after the anniversary of incorporation, or within any extension granted by the VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter the exact name and registration number as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the English name appearing on the IC certificate; no translation is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the registered office in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This may be the registered agent's office; a physical trading address in a high-tax jurisdiction must not be listed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the Vanuatu-registered agent that the company has no outstanding obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent confirms that the IC is not carrying on business in Vanuatu, preserving the tax-exempt character.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A list of current directors and shareholders or a statement that the register is kept at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted. Nominee filers may be listed, but beneficial ownership disclosures under the AML/CFT regime must be lodged separately.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file Form 9 triggers a VFSC penalty of VT 5,000 to VT 10,000 plus VT 1,000 per month of continued default. Persistent non-compliance results in administrative strike-off and a restoration fee. No corporate income tax late-filing penalty applies because the IC has zero income tax liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% under the Vanuatu income tax framework and the International Companies Act; no tax is withheld from dividends paid by an IC to its non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement in force. Because the domestic dividend withholding tax rate is zero, no treaty relief claim is necessary. If a foreign tax authority requests evidence of tax status, the IC's registered agent may obtain a Certificate of Corporate Existence from the VFSC confirming the company's tax-exempt status and Vanuatu registration. Applications should be lodged at least 10 working days before the dividend record date.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic law imposes 0% withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest paid by an IC. No treaty rate reduction is available because no DTA is in force; the foreign recipient must address any home-country tax under its own tax code.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No transfer pricing documentation threshold is prescribed under Vanuatu law because the IC is exempt from income tax. For prudent group reporting, prepare a Master File where consolidated related-party transactions exceed VUV 1.3 billion (approximately EUR 10 million) or global revenue exceeds USD 50 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted UK-style Economic Substance Regulations. The International Companies Act requires a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu and compliance with beneficial ownership reporting under the Companies and Trusts Service Providers (Amendment) Act 2019. A passive holding of brand IP and collection of e-commerce revenue for designer blind box toys is not subject to Vanuatu economic substance tests.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion via Sham Offshore Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to invoice and retain e-commerce profits from designer toy sales while the beneficial owner resides in a high-tax country and fails to declare the corporate income, creating the façade of a non-resident company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: derecognition of the IC for false representations. The beneficial owner's home tax authority may re-attribute all profits to the resident individual or parent company, imposing tax penalties of 50–100% of the unpaid tax plus interest at the prescribed statutory rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil where the IC is used as a sham. Directors become jointly and severally liable for the full tax debt, are subject to travel bans preventing departure, and face imprisonment of up to 5 years for fraudulent trading.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company with No Commercial Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a pure shell with no decision-making authority, no business records, no substance in Vanuatu, and no arm's-length contracts; allowing an overseas parent to control all design, sales, inventory and pricing decisions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under foreign general anti-avoidance and CFC rules, the shell IC may be disregarded and all profits attributed to the parent or principal. Vanuatu does not assess substance penalties, but the VFSC may require the registered agent to produce records and may strike off the company for supplying inaccurate information.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil claims for breach of fiduciary duty, quantification of unreported taxes from the deemed taxable presence, personal bankruptcy orders, and, where false accounting is knowingly certified, criminal imprisonment of up to 5 years under applicable company offences legislation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the mandatory beneficial ownership declaration with the VFSC or knowingly shielding a politically exposed person behind nominee directors while conducting designer toy trade through bank accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu AML/CFT legislation, failure to provide accurate beneficial ownership information attracts fines of up to VT 5,000,000 and removal of the registered agent; intermediaries may terminate banking relationships if the IC cannot produce its IC registration number or equivalent tax identifier.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Registered directors, including nominees, are personally liable to fines of up to VT 5 million and imprisonment of up to 5 years for knowingly supplying false statements; travel restrictions may be imposed pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-invoicing imported vinyl resin or over-invoicing exported designer toys to a related distributor, thereby generating hidden wealth through transfer-price manipulation and circumventing customs duties in the destination market.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu Customs and Excise Act penalties include seizure of the goods, fines of up to three times the duty evaded, and revocation of the customs broker license. The foreign importing jurisdiction may also impose customs penalties of up to 200% of the goods' value.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false import/export declarations become personally liable to customs recovery orders, monetary penalties, civil fraud damages, and imprisonment of up to 5 years for fraudulent use of invoices.
